# Exercise

We run through the simple Git workflow shown on slide 7:

- Open a GitHub codespace from your forked workshop repository. Visit the [instructions](../../instructions/index.qmd) page to learn how to do this.

- Within the codespace, adjust the README file by adding your name, ORCID, or any other information you find relevant. Save the changes.

- **Stage** and **commit** the changes. Provide a commit message.
    - You can do so either using the Terminal, or using the built-in Git integration (visible in the left-hand pane).

- **Push** the changes to your remote repository on GitHub.

- Verify the changes on GitHub in the README.

- Optional: further personalize the repository to your liking.
